title: Antibiotic toxicity screening on seedling emergence: beyond traditional species
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,847-865
DOI: 10.1039/D6EM00053C, Paper

R. Silvana Cortés-Lagunes, Andrea-Lorena Garduño-Jiménez, Wenshi Bao, Juan Carlos Durán-Álvarez, Felicity C. T. Elder, Joshua Greenwood, John H. Nightingale, Fan Zhang, Laura J. Carter
Antibiotics are prevalent environmental pollutants with documented plant uptake and effects. Germination and seedling emergence are critical stages of plant development, making toxicity tests valuable for assessing the terrestrial risk.
